Nasdaq-listed Perpetuals com, led by former FTX Europe head Patrick Gruhn, has filed with the SEC to operate a tokenized securities venue under the five-year Innovation Exemption.

It is the second firm to pursue U.S. tokenized stock trading under the framework, after the OKX-ICE joint venture. Tokens must carry the same dividend and voting rights as ordinary shares, and companies have 30 days to object.

Polygon Completes Coinme Acquisition, Turns Open Money Stack Into US-Regulated Payments Platform

Polygon Labs has completed its acquisition of Coinme, integrating regulated U.S. money transfer services into the Polygon Open Money Stack. The platform now covers 48 U.S. states, holding 37 state-level money transmitter licenses and 11 applicable exemptions, and is registered with FinCEN as a money services business. Tazapay, Mesh, Toku and Kira are the first customers, using it for cross-border business payments, account top-ups, global payroll and USD services. — link

U.S. September CPI Broadly Exceeds Expectations, Annual Rate Rises to 3.7%, Highest Since May

U.S. September headline CPI rose 3.7% year over year, the highest since May, exceeding market expectations of 3.6%. Month over month, unadjusted CPI increased 0.6%, the highest since April. Core CPI rose 2.6% year over year, the highest since June, above expectations of 2.5%. Seasonally adjusted core CPI increased 0.3% month over month, above expectations of 0.2%. — link

Binance to Delist QUICK and EPIC on October 28

Binance announced it will delist QuickSwap (QUICK) and Epic Chain (EPIC) on October 28 at 03:00 UTC, canceling all outstanding spot orders.
